post.summary: Record an artifacts cache usage event
post.description: Records an artifacts cache usage event. The body of this request is an array of cache usage events. The supported event types are `HIT` and `MISS`. The source is either `LOCAL` the cache event was on the users filesystem cache or `REMOTE` if the cache event is for a remote cache. When the event is a `HIT` the request also accepts a number `duration` which is the time taken to generate the artifact in the cache.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Client-Ci
parameters.description: The continuous integration or delivery environment where this artifact is downloaded.

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Client-Interactive
parameters.description: 1 if the client is an interactive shell. Otherwise 0

sessionId.description: A UUID (universally unique identifer) for the session that generated this event.

source.description: One of `LOCAL` or `REMOTE`. `LOCAL` specifies that the cache event was from the user's filesystem cache. `REMOTE` specifies that the cache event is from a remote cache.

event.description: One of `HIT` or `MISS`. `HIT` specifies that a cached artifact for `hash` was found in the cache. `MISS` specifies that a cached artifact with `hash` was not found.

duration.description: The time taken to generate the artifact. This should be sent as a body parameter on `HIT` events.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: content-Length
parameters.description: The artifact size in bytes

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Duration
parameters.description: The time taken to generate the uploaded artifact in milliseconds.

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Client-Ci
parameters.description: The continuous integration or delivery environment where this artifact was generated.

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Client-Interactive
parameters.description: 1 if the client is an interactive shell. Otherwise 0

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Tag
parameters.description: The base64 encoded tag for this artifact. The value is sent back to clients when the artifact is downloaded as the header `x-artifact-tag`

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Sha
parameters.description: The SHA of the source control revision that generated this artifact.

parameters.name: x-Artifact-Dirty-Hash
parameters.description: A hash representing uncommitted changes in the working directory when this artifact was generated.
